chapter_seo_title: Zhuxian Sword Awakens – Stone Legs Found in Hell
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen discovers the legendary Zhuxian Sword in the underworld. Suiren's relic stirs, the sword escapes, and two stone legs unite, hinting at a primordial secret.
